title: CISSP Command Centre question

objective.description: Outline objective number, e.g. "1.9". Links the question to a domain sub-topic page.

difficulty.description: 1 terminology, 2 concept, 3 application, 4 troubleshooting/analysis, 5 complex scenario, 6 hard with several plausible answers

scenario.description: Null, or the id of a shared case study in scenarios (e.g. "sc-d7-02") for multi-question scenario sets

correct.description: Zero-based option indices. Exactly one for single; two or more for multi.

rationales.description: One per option, same order as options: why each is right or wrong.

tags.description: Free tags plus controlled ones: first-step, best-step, management, technical, outline2027

$comment: Cross-field rules enforced by tests/validate-content.js, not expressible here: rationales.length === options.length; every correct index < options.length; single => correct.length === 1; multi => correct.length >= 2; id prefix matches domain; objective prefix matches domain; followUpId exists in the bank.
